title: 02 · Lullwater: sleep session
strengths: The timer as hero type (18:24 in Instrument Serif) with the line 'left · fades out by 23:40' is a real product idea, and the sound-mix pill 'Rain on the reed beds · 40%' is a detail only a sleep app would have.
Controls are bottom-weighted with an 80 pt play target, skip 15, a moon for the sleep timer and a mixer: the right transport set.
slop_signals: A glowing orb with a feathered white swirl inside it, on an indigo-to-peach gradient, ringed by concentric hairlines and scattered stars: the canonical AI 'calm app' image. Calm, Oura and Ten Percent Happier use a photo, a flat grainy gradient or nothing.
Two heroes compete: the orb (with 'breathe in 4 · 7 · 8' inside it) and the 95 px timer directly below it.
A rendered reflection of the orb on the water, plus a glow ring around the peach play button: glow stacked on glow.
The concentric rings around the orb carry no data (the 4-7-8 phase is not drawn on them).
fixes: Choose one hero: either the breath cue (a crisp disc or a ring whose arc is the phase) or the timer; remove the other from the upper half.
Replace the painted sky and reflection with one flat grainy gradient (the Ten Percent Happier reference) or a photographic horizon.
Remove the rings, the stars and the play-button glow; keep film grain only on a flat gradient.

references.what: A flat grainy gradient, a title, and controls low on the screen; nothing is drawn in the middle.
A single photograph, one title line, three controls and a scrubber: calm comes from restraint, not from an object.
Dark sky, narrator and author as label-value pairs, plain transport row.
Also centres a glowing object; shows how quickly that reads as a template rather than a product.
A blurred photo with the title and controls in the lower third.
